notes: Live panels from a description: 'make a panel that shows gold's price and my open trades' writes itself in about half a minute and stays (sandboxed: read-only tools and public pages only). Hand control: 'hand control on' makes your index finger a pointer on the webcam; pinch to click or drag a panel, swipe an open hand to close a pop-up. Holo mode's life map: your shifts, pay, trades, agents, ventures and more orbit the core; tap, pinch or say one to open it ('life map off' hides it).
